facts.en: Completed a BA in Media Studies at Fictional Institute D088 in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构院校 D088 完成媒体研究文学学士学位。

facts.en: Worked as a content coordination assistant at Fictional Learning Publisher D088 from 2021-03 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-03 至 2026-08 在虚构学习出版商 D088 担任内容协调助理。

facts.en: Prepared English and Chinese content packets for review using approved text supplied by editors.
facts.zh: 使用编辑提供的获批文本，准备英文及中文内容资料供审阅。

facts.en: Checked headings, missing strings and consistent product terms against an internal bilingual glossary.
facts.zh: 依据内部双语词汇表检查标题、缺失字符串及产品术语一致性。

facts.en: With bilingual editors, coordinated a 2025-06 review of 80 help-text strings.
facts.zh: 在 2025-06 与双语编辑合作协调 80 条帮助文本字符串的审查。

facts.en: The team flagged 12 terminology inconsistencies among those 80 strings; editors approved 10 corrections and kept 2 pending.
facts.zh: 团队在该批 80 条字符串中标出 12 处术语不一致；编辑批准 10 处更正，保留 2 处待定。

facts.en: The candidate assembled comparison sheets and entered approved changes; editors determined translation accuracy and final wording.
facts.zh: 候选人整理比较表并录入获批变更；编辑决定翻译准确性及最终措辞。

facts.en: This was internal localization assistance, not certified translation, interpreting or independent legal-language review.
facts.zh: 这是内部本地化协助，并非认证翻译、口译或独立法律语言审查。

facts.en: Prepared a 2026-02 glossary handover guide approved for the content team.
facts.zh: 2026-02 准备词汇表交接指南，获批供内容团队使用。

facts.en: Drafted a multilingual audio-caption plan in 2026-05; no recordings or captions were published.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草多语言音频字幕计划；未发布录音或字幕。

facts.en: Maintained language-version identifiers and tracked unresolved review questions without substituting guessed text.
facts.zh: 维护语言版本标识并跟踪未解决审阅问题，不用猜测文本替代。

facts.en: At the 2025-11 release peak, coordinated 6 content packets; the routine 2026-08 allocation was 2.
facts.zh: 在 2025-11 发布高峰期协调 6 份内容资料；2026-08 常规分工为 2 份。

facts.en: Completed a 2024-10 short course on plain-language editing; no translator accreditation was awarded.
facts.zh: 2024-10 完成通俗语言编辑短课；未授予翻译认证。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Cultural Reading Circle V088 on weekends from 2023-02 to 2023-08 while employed.
facts.zh: 2023-02 至 2023-08 任职期间，周末在虚构文化阅读社团 V088 志愿服务。

facts.en: For that circle, organized discussion prompts provided by facilitators rather than interpreting participant conversations.
facts.zh: 为该社团整理引导师提供的讨论提示，而非为参与者对话口译。

facts.en: Creates personal watercolor studies of imaginary coastal signs as a hobby.
facts.zh: 以创作虚构海岸标识水彩习作为爱好。

facts.en: A draft profile describes the candidate as a certified translator, but neither an accreditation record nor a translation qualification is supplied.
facts.zh: 一份简介草稿将候选人描述为认证翻译，但未提供认证记录或翻译资格。

facts.en: Sent review reminders and consolidated editor comments into a single tracked issue list.
facts.zh: 发送审阅提醒，并将编辑意见整合至单一可跟踪问题清单。

facts.en: No quantified bilingual proficiency test score or independent interpreting assignment is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录量化双语能力考试分数或独立口译任务。
